title: LemonMatrix 3D Mesh Generation Benchmark Result
description: A single image-to-3D-mesh benchmark run for one model (Lemonade's trellis recipe, POST /v1/3d/generations). Deliberately separate from result.schema.json: mesh generation throughput is not comparable to LLM token throughput, so meshgen runs are never mixed into the main model/router leaderboard.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run (UUID recommended).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the run started.

name.description: Model id as registered in Lemonade, e.g. TRELLIS-image-large.

checkpoint.description: Underlying HF checkpoint, if known, e.g. owner/repo.

config.description: The matrix axes for this run.

power_cap_w.description: Applied power cap in watts, if power_state is power_capped.

environment.description: Fingerprint of the machine and software stack. Auto-discovered from the profile. Required for any run to be comparable.

igpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx1151.

dgpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx950 -- confirmed more reliable than name for at least one real datacenter card whose name field was a bare numeric string.

backend_version.description: Version of the underlying mesh-gen engine build, if Lemonade reports it as installed.

metrics.description: Mesh-generation latency and throughput for a fixed input image. The response is the raw mesh binary with no timing field, so generation time is measured client-side as wall-clock time around the request -- this times the network round trip to whatever machine the profile actually points at, not local hardware.

generation_time_ms.description: Mean wall-clock time to generate one mesh from the input image.

trial_count.description: Number of measured (non-warmup) trials included in aggregated metrics.

resolution.description: Output mesh resolution requested, if any -- materially affects generation time.

seed.description: Seed passed on the request, if any.

validity.description: Confounder controls. A run that fails a gate must set valid=false and record why.

valid.description: False if any hard gate failed. Invalid runs are shown but never ranked.

warmup_discarded.description: True if warmup iterations were excluded from timing.

exclusive_run.description: True if no competing model workload ran during measurement, per server-verified /api/v1/health polling where possible.

model_reload_free.description: True if the model stayed resident for the whole run (no reload tax).

notes.description: Any flags, caveats, or reasons a gate failed.
